tiles.title: Services
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "service.name") AS value FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'

tiles.title: Request Rate
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT ROUND(SUM(data_point_count), 2) AS value FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') ~ '$environment' AND COALESCE("http.request.method", 'unknown') ~ '$method' AND COALESCE("http.route", 'unknown') ~ '$route' AND COALESCE(CAST("http.response.status_code" AS VARCHAR), 'unknown') ~ '$status_code'

tiles.title: Error Rate
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(data_point_count) FILTER (WHERE CAST("http.response.status_code" AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%') / NULLIF(SUM(data_point_count), 0), 2) AS value FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') ~ '$environment' AND COALESCE("http.request.method", 'unknown') ~ '$method' AND COALESCE("http.route", 'unknown') ~ '$route'

tiles.title: P95 Latency
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT ROUND(MAX(data_point_max) * 1000.0, 2) AS value FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') ~ '$environment' AND COALESCE("http.request.method", 'unknown') ~ '$method' AND COALESCE("http.route", 'unknown') ~ '$route' AND COALESCE(CAST("http.response.status_code" AS VARCHAR), 'unknown') ~ '$status_code'

tiles.title: Trace Services
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "service.name") AS services FROM $traces_dataset

tiles.title: Total Traces
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT span_trace_id) AS traces FROM $traces_dataset

tiles.title: Log Errors
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS errors FROM $logs_dataset WHERE severity_text IN ('ERROR','FATAL') OR p_log_category IN ('ERROR','FATAL') OR "exception.message" IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Metric Families
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT metric_name) AS metrics FROM $metrics_dataset

tiles.title: Traffic by Service
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service, SUM(data_point_count) AS requests FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') ~ '$environment' AND COALESCE("http.request.method", 'unknown') ~ '$method' AND COALESCE("http.route", 'unknown') ~ '$route' AND COALESCE(CAST("http.response.status_code" AS VARCHAR), 'unknown') ~ '$status_code' GROUP BY time_bin, service ORDER BY time_bin ASC, service ASC

tiles.title: P95 Latency by Route
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COALESCE("http.route", 'unknown') AS route, ROUND(MAX(data_point_max) * 1000.0, 2) AS p95_ms FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') ~ '$environment' AND COALESCE("http.request.method", 'unknown') ~ '$method' AND COALESCE("http.route", 'unknown') ~ '$route' AND COALESCE(CAST("http.response.status_code" AS VARCHAR), 'unknown') ~ '$status_code' GROUP BY time_bin, route ORDER BY time_bin ASC, route ASC

tiles.title: Errors by Status Code
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COALESCE(CAST("http.response.status_code" AS VARCHAR), 'unknown') AS status_code, SUM(data_point_count) AS requests FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') ~ '$environment' AND COALESCE("http.request.method", 'unknown') ~ '$method' AND COALESCE("http.route", 'unknown') ~ '$route' GROUP BY time_bin, status_code ORDER BY time_bin ASC, status_code ASC

tiles.title: Request Rate by Method
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE("http.request.method", 'unknown') AS method, SUM(data_point_count) AS requests FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') ~ '$environment' AND COALESCE("http.request.method", 'unknown') ~ '$method' AND COALESCE("http.route", 'unknown') ~ '$route' AND COALESCE(CAST("http.response.status_code" AS VARCHAR), 'unknown') ~ '$status_code' GROUP BY method ORDER BY requests DESC

tiles.title: Top Route Traffic
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE("http.route", 'unknown') AS route, SUM(data_point_count) AS requests FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') ~ '$environment' AND COALESCE("http.request.method", 'unknown') ~ '$method' AND COALESCE("http.route", 'unknown') ~ '$route' AND COALESCE(CAST("http.response.status_code" AS VARCHAR), 'unknown') ~ '$status_code' GROUP BY route ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 10

tiles.title: Average Request Duration
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COALESCE("http.route", 'unknown') AS route, ROUND(1000.0 * SUM(data_point_sum) / NULLIF(SUM(data_point_count), 0), 2) AS avg_ms FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') ~ '$environment' AND COALESCE("http.request.method", 'unknown') ~ '$method' AND COALESCE("http.route", 'unknown') ~ '$route' AND COALESCE(CAST("http.response.status_code" AS VARCHAR), 'unknown') ~ '$status_code' GROUP BY time_bin, route ORDER BY time_bin ASC, route ASC

tiles.title: Status Code Mix
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE(CAST("http.response.status_code" AS VARCHAR), 'unknown') AS status_code, SUM(data_point_count) AS requests FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment.name", 'unknown') ~ '$environment' AND COALESCE("http.request.method", 'unknown') ~ '$method' AND COALESCE("http.route", 'unknown') ~ '$route' GROUP BY status_code ORDER BY requests DESC

tiles.title: Log Volume by Severity
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COALESCE(severity_text, p_log_category, 'unknown') AS severity, COUNT(*) AS logs
FROM $logs_dataset
GROUP BY time_bin, severity
ORDER BY time_bin ASC, severity ASC

tiles.title: Error Rate from Logs
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity_text IN ('ERROR','FATAL') OR p_log_category IN ('ERROR','FATAL') OR "exception.message" IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS error_rate_pct
FROM $logs_dataset
GROUP BY time_bin
ORDER BY time_bin ASC

tiles.title: Errors by Service
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service, COUNT(*) AS errors
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE severity_text IN ('ERROR','FATAL') OR p_log_category IN ('ERROR','FATAL')
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY errors DESC
LIMIT 20

tiles.title: Recent Error Logs
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service, COALESCE(severity_text, p_log_category, 'unknown') AS severity, body, trace_id, span_id
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE severity_text IN ('ERROR','FATAL','WARN') OR p_log_category IN ('ERROR','FATAL','WARN')
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Trace Throughput by Service
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service, COUNT(DISTINCT span_trace_id) AS traces
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'
GROUP BY time_bin, service
ORDER BY time_bin ASC, service ASC

tiles.title: P95 Span Latency by Service
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE span_duration_ns IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'
GROUP BY time_bin, service
ORDER BY time_bin ASC, service ASC

tiles.title: Span Errors by Service
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service, COUNT(*) AS errors
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE span_status_code = 2 OR "error.type" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY errors DESC
LIMIT 20

tiles.title: Slowest Operations
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service, COALESCE(span_name, 'unknown') AS operation, span_trace_id, ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 2) AS duration_ms, span_status_code
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE span_duration_ns IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY span_duration_ns DESC
LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Metric Inventory
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT metric_name, metric_type, metric_unit, COUNT(DISTINCT __series_hash_u64) AS series, COUNT(*) AS points, MIN(p_timestamp) AS first_seen, MAX(p_timestamp) AS last_seen FROM $metrics_dataset GROUP BY metric_name, metric_type, metric_unit ORDER BY metric_name

tiles.title: Runtime Identity
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT "service.name" AS service, "service.version" AS service_version, "deployment.environment.name" AS environment, COUNT(DISTINCT metric_name) AS metrics, MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service' GROUP BY service, service_version, environment ORDER BY service

tiles.title: Route Inventory from Traces
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service, COALESCE("http.route", span_name, 'unknown') AS route, COUNT(*) AS spans, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2 OR "error.type" IS NOT NULL) AS errors
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'
GROUP BY service, route
ORDER BY spans DESC
LIMIT 50
